Args.body:
🔧 **Player Build CS0246 fix — TreasuryModels 漏 strip guard**

Tim 派 Errors_20_52_48.log 分析:

## Root cause (T18 family 變體)

- `UCL_TreasuryLedger.cs` (2026-05-13 Zeta) 已 strip `#if UNITY_EDITOR` guard, 理由「純 file IO + crypto + replay 邏輯, 無 Editor 依賴」
- 但相依的 type 定義 `UCL_TreasuryModels.cs` (`TreasuryEntryType` / `TreasuryLedgerEntry`) **仍 wrap in #if UNITY_EDITOR**
- Player Build: Ledger compile but Models excluded → 8 處 CS0246 missing type

## Why Editor passes Player fails (T18 family 重演)

| Build | UNITY_EDITOR define | Models.cs |
|---|---|---|
| Editor | ✅ defined | compile, types 存在 ✓ |
| Player | ❌ undefined | 整檔被 #if 排除, types 消失 → consumer CS0246 |

Editor check_compile 永遠 0 errors 看不出。

## Fix

Strip `UCL_TreasuryModels.cs` 的 `#if UNITY_EDITOR ... #endif` 包裹, 對齊 Ledger 一致決策。

Sanity check: grep `UnityEditor|EditorApplication|AssetDatabase` 三檔 (Ledger/Models/Paths) → 0 hit, 確認純 data + IO, 無真 Editor 依賴。

註: `Cmd_Treasury.cs` 仍保留 guard (它有真 Editor 依賴 — UnityEditor.AssetDatabase 等), 沒動。

## Commits + Verify

- `0fa00dd` UCL_Core: TreasuryModels strip guard
- `bf51814` UCL bump
- `56c890f` Main bump
- Editor check_compile: 0 errors ✅
- Player Build: 待 Tim 第 5 輪驗收

## Lesson logged

「同 namespace 不同 .cs guard 不一致」family — strip/add file guard 時必 grep 整 namespace 確保一致, 否則 Player Build 才暴露。

Tim 再 build 試試。a~ 🦈
